Although the notice was issued to the informant/ victim, however, the notice could not be served.
Since the charge sheet has been filed in the present case for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 366/ 363/109 of the IPC, the notice on the informant/ victim is not required.
Hence, the notice is dispensed with.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Lachhipur P.S. Case No.84 of 2023 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No.19 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 363/ 366/ 323/
376(2) (n) /376(3)/109 of the IPC read with Section 6/4(2) of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Sonepur.
The petitioner had approached the learned Children's Court, Sonepur in Special G.R. No.19 of 2023 praying for grant of bail.
The learned Court below vide its order dated 12.03.2024 rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
4.

Lachhipur P.S. alleging that, on 23.08.2023 night, the complainant did not find her daughter in her room, who is aged about 14 years of age.
She had fled away somewhere from her house.
The complainant along with her family members searched for her daughter everywhere, but they could not trace her out.

Hence, the F.I.R.
5.
It is alleged against the petitioner that, he had aided the principal accused Bishnu Sikka for committing the offence of kidnapping and subsequently committed sexual assault on the victim.
The petitioner has been in custody since 10.02.2024.

The petitioner is not the principle accused, rather he had allegedly helped the main accused in kidnapping the girl, there is allegation of sexual assault being committed by this petitioner to the victim 6.

Regard being had to the period of custody of the petitioner i.e. since 10.02.2024 and the nature of the accusation and the fact that the petitioner has only aided the principal accused for commission of the offence and there is no specific overt act attributed to the petitioner regarding the offence related to sexual assault to the minor girl, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
7.

In the event the petitioner is found wanting for violation of any of the bail conditions imposed by this Court or the trial Court even on a single occasion, the prosecution is at liberty to move appropriate application before the Court below for cancellation of the concession of bail granted by this Court.

If such application is filed, the trial Court should decide the application on its own merit.
8.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
